name: VL53L0X time-of-flight distance sensor
description: ST FlightSense time-of-flight sensor that times 940 nm laser pulses to measure absolute distance up to 2 m, read in millimetres over I2C (up to 400 kHz) at address 0x29. The bare chip runs from 2.6-3.5 V. Sold as: GY-530 / GY-VL53L0XV2 VL53L0X time-of-flight distance module (purple 6-pin board: VIN, GND, SCL, SDA, GPIO1, XSHUT) with a 2.8 V regulator, MOSFET level shifters and 10 kΩ pull-ups on SDA/SCL, so VIN takes 3.3 V or 5 V.
eli5: It flashes a tiny invisible laser and times how long the light takes to bounce back, which tells you how far away something is, up to about 2 metres.

pins.name: VIN
pins.description: Supply input, 3.3-5 V (on-board LDO makes the chip's 2.8 V)

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock, level shifted, 10 kΩ pull-up to VIN on the board

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data, level shifted, 10 kΩ pull-up to VIN on the board

pins.name: GPIO1
pins.description: Interrupt output (open drain, 47 kΩ pull-up to 2.8 V, not level shifted); goes low when a new range is ready. Not needed for basic use

pins.name: XSHUT
pins.description: Shutdown input, active low, 47 kΩ pull-up to 2.8 V, not level shifted. Leave unconnected for normal use; to switch the sensor off pull it low (never drive it with 5 V)

supplierQuery: GY-530 VL53L0X time of flight laser distance sensor module
buildNotes: Peel off the protective film over the sensor window before use, or readings will be wrong.

Registers are 8-bit indexes with MSB-first data. Model ID register 0xC0 reads 0xEE. ST publishes no register map: the driver replays ST API init (SPAD setup, tuning settings, VHV and phase calibration) as ported by Pololu.

Each range is a 16-bit value in mm at 0x1E (RESULT_RANGE_STATUS 0x14 + 10). Wait for RESULT_INTERRUPT_STATUS 0x13 bits 2:0 to be non-zero, read, then write 0x01 to SYSTEM_INTERRUPT_CLEAR 0x0B. 8190 or 8191 mm means no target in range.

Every VL53L0X starts at address 0x29. For several on one bus hold their XSHUT pins low, release them one at a time and set a new address (register 0x8A). XSHUT is not level shifted: pull it low, never drive it with 5 V.
Default timing budget is about 33 ms (range about 1.2 m). long_range() reaches about 2 m in the dark; set_timing_budget_us(200000) gives the most accurate readings.
Ranging peaks at about 40 mA; keep power wires short.

# VL53L0X time-of-flight distance sensor (ST), MicroPython driver.
# A port of Pololu's vl53l0x-arduino library, which reproduces the init, SPAD, tuning,
# timing-budget and reference-calibration sequence of ST's VL53L0X API (STSW-IMG005).
# ST's datasheet has no register map; register names below are the API's.
import time

_SYSRANGE_START = 0x00
_SYSTEM_SEQUENCE_CONFIG = 0x01
_SYSTEM_INTERMEASUREMENT_PERIOD = 0x04
_SYSTEM_INTERRUPT_CONFIG_GPIO = 0x0A
_SYSTEM_INTERRUPT_CLEAR = 0x0B
_RESULT_INTERRUPT_STATUS = 0x13
_RESULT_RANGE_STATUS = 0x14     # range in mm is the 16-bit word at RESULT_RANGE_STATUS + 10
_GLOBAL_CONFIG_VCSEL_WIDTH = 0x32
_FINAL_RANGE_CONFIG_MIN_COUNT_RATE_RTN_LIMIT = 0x44
_MSRC_CONFIG_TIMEOUT_MACROP = 0x46
_FINAL_RANGE_CONFIG_VALID_PHASE_LOW = 0x47
_FINAL_RANGE_CONFIG_VALID_PHASE_HIGH = 0x48
_DYNAMIC_SPAD_NUM_REQUESTED_REF_SPAD = 0x4E
_DYNAMIC_SPAD_REF_EN_START_OFFSET = 0x4F
_PRE_RANGE_CONFIG_VCSEL_PERIOD = 0x50
_PRE_RANGE_CONFIG_TIMEOUT_MACROP_HI = 0x51
_PRE_RANGE_CONFIG_VALID_PHASE_LOW = 0x56
_PRE_RANGE_CONFIG_VALID_PHASE_HIGH = 0x57
_MSRC_CONFIG_CONTROL = 0x60
_FINAL_RANGE_CONFIG_VCSEL_PERIOD = 0x70
_FINAL_RANGE_CONFIG_TIMEOUT_MACROP_HI = 0x71
_GPIO_HV_MUX_ACTIVE_HIGH = 0x84
_VHV_CONFIG_PAD_SCL_SDA__EXTSUP_HV = 0x89
_I2C_SLAVE_DEVICE_ADDRESS = 0x8A
_GLOBAL_CONFIG_SPAD_ENABLES_REF_0 = 0xB0
_GLOBAL_CONFIG_REF_EN_START_SELECT = 0xB6
_IDENTIFICATION_MODEL_ID = 0xC0   # reads 0xEE (datasheet table 4)
_OSC_CALIBRATE_VAL = 0xF8
_ALGO_PHASECAL_LIM = 0x30
_ALGO_PHASECAL_CONFIG_TIMEOUT = 0x30

# ST API default tuning settings (register, value); 0xFF selects the register page.
_TUNING = (
    (0xFF, 0x01), (0x00, 0x00), (0xFF, 0x00), (0x09, 0x00), (0x10, 0x00), (0x11, 0x00),
    (0x24, 0x01), (0x25, 0xFF), (0x75, 0x00), (0xFF, 0x01), (0x4E, 0x2C), (0x48, 0x00),
    (0x30, 0x20), (0xFF, 0x00), (0x30, 0x09), (0x54, 0x00), (0x31, 0x04), (0x32, 0x03),
    (0x40, 0x83), (0x46, 0x25), (0x60, 0x00), (0x27, 0x00), (0x50, 0x06), (0x51, 0x00),
    (0x52, 0x96), (0x56, 0x08), (0x57, 0x30), (0x61, 0x00), (0x62, 0x00), (0x64, 0x00),
    (0x65, 0x00), (0x66, 0xA0), (0xFF, 0x01), (0x22, 0x32), (0x47, 0x14), (0x49, 0xFF),
    (0x4A, 0x00), (0xFF, 0x00), (0x7A, 0x0A), (0x7B, 0x00), (0x78, 0x21), (0xFF, 0x01),
    (0x23, 0x34), (0x42, 0x00), (0x44, 0xFF), (0x45, 0x26), (0x46, 0x05), (0x40, 0x40),
    (0x0E, 0x06), (0x20, 0x1A), (0x43, 0x40), (0xFF, 0x00), (0x34, 0x03), (0x35, 0x44),
    (0xFF, 0x01), (0x31, 0x04), (0x4B, 0x09), (0x4C, 0x05), (0x4D, 0x04), (0xFF, 0x00),
    (0x44, 0x00), (0x45, 0x20), (0x47, 0x08), (0x48, 0x28), (0x67, 0x00), (0x70, 0x04),
    (0x71, 0x01), (0x72, 0xFE), (0x76, 0x00), (0x77, 0x00), (0xFF, 0x01), (0x0D, 0x01),
    (0xFF, 0x00), (0x80, 0x01), (0x01, 0xF8), (0xFF, 0x01), (0x8E, 0x01), (0x00, 0x01),
    (0xFF, 0x00), (0x80, 0x00),
)


def _decode_vcsel(v):
    return (v + 1) << 1


def _macro_period_ns(vcsel_pclks):
    return (2304 * vcsel_pclks * 1655 + 500) // 1000


def _decode_timeout(v):
    return ((v & 0xFF) << ((v >> 8) & 0xFF)) + 1


def _encode_timeout(mclks):
    if mclks <= 0:
        return 0
    ls = mclks - 1
    ms = 0
    while ls & 0xFFFFFF00:
        ls >>= 1
        ms += 1
    return (ms << 8) | (ls & 0xFF)


def _mclks_to_us(mclks, vcsel_pclks):
    m = _macro_period_ns(vcsel_pclks)
    return (mclks * m + 500) // 1000


def _us_to_mclks(us, vcsel_pclks):
    m = _macro_period_ns(vcsel_pclks)
    return (us * 1000 + m // 2) // m


class VL53L0X:
    def __init__(self, i2c, address=0x29, io_2v8=True, timeout_ms=500):
        """io_2v8=True suits modules whose SDA/SCL are pulled up to the 2.8 V supply
        (GY-530, Pololu, Adafruit). Use False only with 1.8 V I/O on a bare chip."""
        self.i2c = i2c
        self.addr = address
        self.timeout_ms = timeout_ms
        self.range_status = 0
        self._buf1 = bytearray(1)
        if self._r8(_IDENTIFICATION_MODEL_ID) != 0xEE:
            raise OSError('VL53L0X not found (model id 0x%02X, expected 0xEE)' % self._r8(_IDENTIFICATION_MODEL_ID))
        if io_2v8:
            self._w8(_VHV_CONFIG_PAD_SCL_SDA__EXTSUP_HV, self._r8(_VHV_CONFIG_PAD_SCL_SDA__EXTSUP_HV) | 0x01)
        # Set I2C standard mode and read the stop variable.
        self._w8(0x88, 0x00)
        self._w8(0x80, 0x01)
        self._w8(0xFF, 0x01)
        self._w8(0x00, 0x00)
        self._stop = self._r8(0x91)
        self._w8(0x00, 0x01)
        self._w8(0xFF, 0x00)
        self._w8(0x80, 0x00)
        # Disable SIGNAL_RATE_MSRC and SIGNAL_RATE_PRE_RANGE limit checks.
        self._w8(_MSRC_CONFIG_CONTROL, self._r8(_MSRC_CONFIG_CONTROL) | 0x12)
        self.set_signal_rate_limit(0.25)
        self._w8(_SYSTEM_SEQUENCE_CONFIG, 0xFF)
        # Reference SPADs from the factory NVM.
        count, aperture = self._spad_info()
        spads = bytearray(self._rd(_GLOBAL_CONFIG_SPAD_ENABLES_REF_0, 6))
        self._w8(0xFF, 0x01)
        self._w8(_DYNAMIC_SPAD_REF_EN_START_OFFSET, 0x00)
        self._w8(_DYNAMIC_SPAD_NUM_REQUESTED_REF_SPAD, 0x2C)
        self._w8(0xFF, 0x00)
        self._w8(_GLOBAL_CONFIG_REF_EN_START_SELECT, 0xB4)
        first = 12 if aperture else 0
        enabled = 0
        for i in range(48):
            if i < first or enabled == count:
                spads[i // 8] &= ~(1 << (i % 8)) & 0xFF
            elif (spads[i // 8] >> (i % 8)) & 1:
                enabled += 1
        self._wr(_GLOBAL_CONFIG_SPAD_ENABLES_REF_0, spads)
        for reg, val in _TUNING:
            self._w8(reg, val)
        # New-sample-ready interrupt on GPIO1, active low.
        self._w8(_SYSTEM_INTERRUPT_CONFIG_GPIO, 0x04)
        self._w8(_GPIO_HV_MUX_ACTIVE_HIGH, self._r8(_GPIO_HV_MUX_ACTIVE_HIGH) & ~0x10 & 0xFF)
        self._w8(_SYSTEM_INTERRUPT_CLEAR, 0x01)
        self._budget_us = self.timing_budget_us()
        # Disable MSRC and TCC by default, then recompute the timing budget.
        self._w8(_SYSTEM_SEQUENCE_CONFIG, 0xE8)
        self.set_timing_budget_us(self._budget_us)
        # VHV and phase reference calibrations.
        self._w8(_SYSTEM_SEQUENCE_CONFIG, 0x01)
        self._ref_calibration(0x40)
        self._w8(_SYSTEM_SEQUENCE_CONFIG, 0x02)
        self._ref_calibration(0x00)
        self._w8(_SYSTEM_SEQUENCE_CONFIG, 0xE8)

    # ---- low level: 8-bit register index, multi-byte values MSB first ----
    def _w8(self, reg, v):
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, bytes((reg, v & 0xFF)))

    def _w16(self, reg, v):
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, bytes((reg, (v >> 8) & 0xFF, v & 0xFF)))

    def _w32(self, reg, v):
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, bytes((reg, (v >> 24) & 0xFF, (v >> 16) & 0xFF, (v >> 8) & 0xFF, v & 0xFF)))

    def _wr(self, reg, data):
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, bytes((reg,)) + bytes(data))

    def _rd(self, reg, n):
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, bytes((reg,)))
        return self.i2c.readfrom(self.addr, n)

    def _r8(self, reg):
        return self._rd(reg, 1)[0]

    def _r16(self, reg):
        d = self._rd(reg, 2)
        return (d[0] << 8) | d[1]

    def _wait(self, cond, what):
        t0 = time.ticks_ms()
        while not cond():
            if time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), t0) > self.timeout_ms:
                raise OSError('VL53L0X timeout waiting for ' + what)
            time.sleep_ms(1)

    def _spad_info(self):
        self._w8(0x80, 0x01)
        self._w8(0xFF, 0x01)
        self._w8(0x00, 0x00)
        self._w8(0xFF, 0x06)
        self._w8(0x83, self._r8(0x83) | 0x04)
        self._w8(0xFF, 0x07)
        self._w8(0x81, 0x01)
        self._w8(0x80, 0x01)
        self._w8(0x94, 0x6B)
        self._w8(0x83, 0x00)
        self._wait(lambda: self._r8(0x83) != 0x00, 'SPAD info')
        self._w8(0x83, 0x01)
        tmp = self._r8(0x92)
        self._w8(0x81, 0x00)
        self._w8(0xFF, 0x06)
        self._w8(0x83, self._r8(0x83) & ~0x04 & 0xFF)
        self._w8(0xFF, 0x01)
        self._w8(0x00, 0x01)
        self._w8(0xFF, 0x00)
        self._w8(0x80, 0x00)
        return tmp & 0x7F, (tmp >> 7) & 0x01

    def _ref_calibration(self, vhv_init_byte):
        self._w8(_SYSRANGE_START, 0x01 | vhv_init_byte)
        self._wait(lambda: self._r8(_RESULT_INTERRUPT_STATUS) & 0x07, 'reference calibration')
        self._w8(_SYSTEM_INTERRUPT_CLEAR, 0x01)
        self._w8(_SYSRANGE_START, 0x00)

    # ---- settings ----
    def set_signal_rate_limit(self, mcps):
        """Minimum return signal rate in MCPS (default 0.25); lower reaches further but
        accepts less reliable readings. Stored as 9.7 fixed point."""
        if not 0 <= mcps <= 511.99:
            raise ValueError('signal rate limit must be 0-511.99 MCPS')
        self._w16(_FINAL_RANGE_CONFIG_MIN_COUNT_RATE_RTN_LIMIT, int(mcps * 128))

    def _steps(self):
        c = self._r8(_SYSTEM_SEQUENCE_CONFIG)
        return {'tcc': (c >> 4) & 1, 'dss': (c >> 3) & 1, 'msrc': (c >> 2) & 1,
                'pre': (c >> 6) & 1, 'final': (c >> 7) & 1}

    def _timeouts(self, en):
        t = {}
        t['pre_vcsel'] = _decode_vcsel(self._r8(_PRE_RANGE_CONFIG_VCSEL_PERIOD))
        t['msrc_mclks'] = self._r8(_MSRC_CONFIG_TIMEOUT_MACROP) + 1
        t['msrc_us'] = _mclks_to_us(t['msrc_mclks'], t['pre_vcsel'])
        t['pre_mclks'] = _decode_timeout(self._r16(_PRE_RANGE_CONFIG_TIMEOUT_MACROP_HI))
        t['pre_us'] = _mclks_to_us(t['pre_mclks'], t['pre_vcsel'])
        t['final_vcsel'] = _decode_vcsel(self._r8(_FINAL_RANGE_CONFIG_VCSEL_PERIOD))
        t['final_mclks'] = _decode_timeout(self._r16(_FINAL_RANGE_CONFIG_TIMEOUT_MACROP_HI))
        if en['pre']:
            t['final_mclks'] -= t['pre_mclks']
        t['final_us'] = _mclks_to_us(t['final_mclks'], t['final_vcsel'])
        return t

    def _used_budget(self, en, t):
        used = 1910 + 960  # start + end overhead
        if en['tcc']:
            used += t['msrc_us'] + 590
        if en['dss']:
            used += 2 * (t['msrc_us'] + 690)
        elif en['msrc']:
            used += t['msrc_us'] + 660
        if en['pre']:
            used += t['pre_us'] + 660
        return used

    def timing_budget_us(self):
        en = self._steps()
        t = self._timeouts(en)
        b = self._used_budget(en, t)
        if en['final']:
            b += t['final_us'] + 550
        return b

    def set_timing_budget_us(self, budget_us):
        """Time allowed for one range (default about 33000 us; 20000 us minimum).
        Longer budgets give more accurate readings: 200000 us for high accuracy."""
        en = self._steps()
        t = self._timeouts(en)
        used = self._used_budget(en, t)
        if en['final']:
            used += 550
            if used > budget_us:
                raise ValueError('timing budget too short')
            mclks = _us_to_mclks(budget_us - used, t['final_vcsel'])
            if en['pre']:
                mclks += t['pre_mclks']
            self._w16(_FINAL_RANGE_CONFIG_TIMEOUT_MACROP_HI, _encode_timeout(mclks))
            self._budget_us = budget_us

    def set_vcsel_pulse_period(self, final, pclks):
        """Laser pulse period in PCLKs: pre-range (final=False) 12/14/16/18, final range
        (final=True) 8/10/12/14. Longer periods (18 and 14) extend the range."""
        reg = (pclks >> 1) - 1
        en = self._steps()
        t = self._timeouts(en)
        if not final:
            phase = {12: 0x18, 14: 0x30, 16: 0x40, 18: 0x50}
            if pclks not in phase:
                raise ValueError('pre-range period must be 12, 14, 16 or 18')
            self._w8(_PRE_RANGE_CONFIG_VALID_PHASE_HIGH, phase[pclks])
            self._w8(_PRE_RANGE_CONFIG_VALID_PHASE_LOW, 0x08)
            self._w8(_PRE_RANGE_CONFIG_VCSEL_PERIOD, reg)
            self._w16(_PRE_RANGE_CONFIG_TIMEOUT_MACROP_HI, _encode_timeout(_us_to_mclks(t['pre_us'], pclks)))
            m = _us_to_mclks(t['msrc_us'], pclks)
            self._w8(_MSRC_CONFIG_TIMEOUT_MACROP, 255 if m > 256 else m - 1)
        else:
            cfg = {8: (0x10, 0x02, 0x0C, 0x30), 10: (0x28, 0x03, 0x09, 0x20),
                   12: (0x38, 0x03, 0x08, 0x20), 14: (0x48, 0x03, 0x07, 0x20)}
            if pclks not in cfg:
                raise ValueError('final-range period must be 8, 10, 12 or 14')
            hi, width, tmo, lim = cfg[pclks]
            self._w8(_FINAL_RANGE_CONFIG_VALID_PHASE_HIGH, hi)
            self._w8(_FINAL_RANGE_CONFIG_VALID_PHASE_LOW, 0x08)
            self._w8(_GLOBAL_CONFIG_VCSEL_WIDTH, width)
            self._w8(_ALGO_PHASECAL_CONFIG_TIMEOUT, tmo)
            self._w8(0xFF, 0x01)
            self._w8(_ALGO_PHASECAL_LIM, lim)
            self._w8(0xFF, 0x00)
            self._w8(_FINAL_RANGE_CONFIG_VCSEL_PERIOD, reg)
            m = _us_to_mclks(t['final_us'], pclks)
            if en['pre']:
                m += t['pre_mclks']
            self._w16(_FINAL_RANGE_CONFIG_TIMEOUT_MACROP_HI, _encode_timeout(m))
        self.set_timing_budget_us(self._budget_us)
        seq = self._r8(_SYSTEM_SEQUENCE_CONFIG)
        self._w8(_SYSTEM_SEQUENCE_CONFIG, 0x02)
        self._ref_calibration(0x00)
        self._w8(_SYSTEM_SEQUENCE_CONFIG, seq)

    def long_range(self):
        """ST's long-range profile: up to about 2 m in the dark, noisier readings."""
        self.set_signal_rate_limit(0.1)
        self.set_vcsel_pulse_period(False, 18)
        self.set_vcsel_pulse_period(True, 14)

    def set_address(self, new_addr):
        self._w8(_I2C_SLAVE_DEVICE_ADDRESS, new_addr & 0x7F)
        self.addr = new_addr

    # ---- ranging ----
    def _load_stop(self):
        self._w8(0x80, 0x01)
        self._w8(0xFF, 0x01)
        self._w8(0x00, 0x00)
        self._w8(0x91, self._stop)
        self._w8(0x00, 0x01)
        self._w8(0xFF, 0x00)
        self._w8(0x80, 0x00)

    def start_continuous(self, period_ms=0):
        """Range continuously: back-to-back (period_ms=0) or once every period_ms."""
        self._load_stop()
        if period_ms:
            osc = self._r16(_OSC_CALIBRATE_VAL)
            if osc:
                period_ms *= osc
            self._w32(_SYSTEM_INTERMEASUREMENT_PERIOD, period_ms)
            self._w8(_SYSRANGE_START, 0x04)  # timed
        else:
            self._w8(_SYSRANGE_START, 0x02)  # back-to-back

    def stop_continuous(self):
        self._w8(_SYSRANGE_START, 0x01)
        self._w8(0xFF, 0x01)
        self._w8(0x00, 0x00)
        self._w8(0x91, 0x00)
        self._w8(0x00, 0x01)
        self._w8(0xFF, 0x00)

    def read(self):
        """Next range in continuous mode, in mm, or None when nothing is in range
        (the chip reports 8190/8191 mm then)."""
        self._wait(lambda: self._r8(_RESULT_INTERRUPT_STATUS) & 0x07, 'range')
        d = self._rd(_RESULT_RANGE_STATUS, 12)
        self._w8(_SYSTEM_INTERRUPT_CLEAR, 0x01)
        self.range_status = (d[0] & 0x78) >> 3  # 11 = range valid (ST API)
        mm = (d[10] << 8) | d[11]
        return None if mm >= 8190 else mm

    def read_single(self):
        """Start one range, wait for it and return mm (or None if out of range)."""
        self._load_stop()
        self._w8(_SYSRANGE_START, 0x01)
        self._wait(lambda: not (self._r8(_SYSRANGE_START) & 0x01), 'range start')
        return self.read()

name: part-vl53l0x
description: Pinout, electrical limits, wiring and MicroPython driver for the VL53L0X time-of-flight laser distance sensor (VL53L0X). Use when designing, wiring, simulating or writing code for a VL53L0X in a Sparkbench project or any ESP32 / Raspberry Pi Pico / Raspberry Pi build.

# VL53L0X time-of-flight distance sensor (VL53L0X)

## Overview
The **VL53L0X** from STMicroelectronics is a FlightSense time-of-flight ranging sensor. It fires 940 nm infrared laser pulses (Class 1, eye-safe) and times the reflections. It gives an absolute distance in millimetres up to about 2 m, whatever the target's colour.
- Default mode: about 33 ms per range, up to about 1.2 m. Long range: up to 2 m in the dark. High accuracy: 200 ms budget, within ±3 % at 1.2 m.
- Field of view 25°.
- Modelled board: **GY-530 / GY-VL53L0XV2 module** (purple, 6-pin header). It has a 2.8 V LDO, MOSFET level shifters on SDA/SCL with 10 kΩ pull-ups to VIN, and 47 kΩ pull-ups to 2.8 V on XSHUT and GPIO1. The circuit is a copy of Pololu's #2490 carrier.

## Pinout (GY-530, header order as printed on the board)
| Pin | Function |
|---|---|
| VIN | Supply, 3.3-5 V (regulated to 2.8 V on the board) |
| GND | Ground |
| SCL | I2C clock (level shifted, 10 kΩ pull-up) |
| SDA | I2C data (level shifted, 10 kΩ pull-up) |
| GPIO1 | Interrupt output, open drain, 2.8 V pull-up, goes low on new range (optional) |
| XSHUT | Shutdown input, active low, 2.8 V pull-up, **not** level shifted (optional) |

## Electrical limits
- Bare chip AVDD: 2.6-3.5 V (typ. 2.8 V), absolute max 3.6 V on any pin. The module's LDO takes 3.3-5 V on VIN.
- Current: 19 mA average while ranging, peaks up to 40 mA. HW standby (XSHUT low) about 5 µA.
- I2C up to 400 kHz. Boot takes up to 1.2 ms after XSHUT goes high.

## Interface details
- **I2C address 0x29** (7-bit; the datasheet gives the 8-bit form 0x52). Change it in software through register 0x8A; it resets on power-up or XSHUT.
- 8-bit register index; multi-byte values are MSB first.
- Reference registers (datasheet table 4): 0xC0 = **0xEE**, 0xC1 = 0xAA, 0xC2 = 0x10.
- ST publishes no register map. Init must replay ST's API: stop variable from 0x91, SPAD info from NVM (poll 0x83, count/type from 0x92), the reference SPAD map at 0xB0-0xB5, the default tuning table, GPIO interrupt config, timing budget, then VHV (0x41) and phase (0x01) reference calibrations. The driver is a port of Pololu's library, which does exactly this.
- Continuous mode: write 0x02 to SYSRANGE_START (0x00); for timed mode write the period to 0x04 and 0x04 to 0x00.
- Result: wait until RESULT_INTERRUPT_STATUS (0x13) bits 2:0 are non-zero, then read the 16-bit range in **mm** at 0x1E (RESULT_RANGE_STATUS 0x14 + 10). Write 0x01 to SYSTEM_INTERRUPT_CLEAR (0x0B) after each read.
- 0x14 bits 6:3 = device range status; 11 means a valid range. 8190/8191 mm means nothing in range.

## Wiring
| Module | ESP32 | Raspberry Pi Pico | Raspberry Pi 4 |
|---|---|---|---|
| VIN | 3V3 | 3V3(OUT) pin 36 | 3.3 V pin 1 |
| GND | GND | GND pin 38 | GND pin 6 |
| SDA | GPIO21 | GP4 (pin 6) | GPIO2 SDA pin 3 |
| SCL | GPIO22 | GP5 (pin 7) | GPIO3 SCL pin 5 |
| XSHUT | leave open (or an open-drain GPIO) | leave open | leave open |
| GPIO1 | optional GPIO (IRQ) | optional GPIO | optional GPIO |

On a Raspberry Pi 4 running Linux use `adafruit-circuitpython-vl53l0x` instead of this MicroPython driver.

## Using the driver
```python
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from vl53l0x import VL53L0X

i2c = I2C(0, sda=Pin(4), scl=Pin(5), freq=400000)   # Pico
tof = VL53L0X(i2c)
tof.start_continuous()
while True:
    mm = tof.read()          # None when nothing is in range
    print('out of range' if mm is None else 'D=%d mm' % mm)
    time.sleep_ms(200)
```
`tof.read_single()` takes one range without continuous mode. `tof.long_range()` reaches about 2 m. `tof.set_timing_budget_us(200000)` gives better accuracy, and `20000` gives faster readings. `tof.range_status` holds the last device range status (11 = valid).

**Several sensors on one bus:** hold every XSHUT low, release one, create `VL53L0X(i2c)` and call `set_address(0x30)`, then release the next and give it another address.

## Gotchas
- **Peel off the protective film** over the sensor window first.
- XSHUT and GPIO1 are 2.8 V signals and not level shifted. Pull XSHUT low with an open-drain output or leave it floating. Never drive it high from a 5 V board.
- Sunlight and other IR shorten the range sharply. Shiny or dark targets also reduce it.
- The address returns to 0x29 at every power cycle or XSHUT reset.
- No offset or crosstalk calibration is done here; a cover glass needs ST's calibration flow.
- The simulator has no ranging timing: in Sparkbench a new range is always ready.
